results.subject: Order not arrived after 2 weeks
results.resolution_strategy: Apologize sincerely for the delivery delay, acknowledge the customer's loyalty and high lifetime value, offer a partial goodwill gesture to maintain satisfaction, and expedite the investigation of the order status.

results.subject: Wrong item delivered
results.resolution_strategy: Apologize sincerely for the error, assure prompt correction by sending the correct item immediately and arrange return of the wrong item with no extra cost. Offer a small goodwill gesture as a token of our regret for the inconvenience caused.

results.subject: Billing error on March invoice
results.resolution_strategy: Empathetic acknowledgment of billing error with apology and goodwill offer to compensate for inconvenience due to high LTV and negative sentiment. Provide clear instructions on corrective action and reassurance to maintain customer trust.

results.subject: Product stopped working
results.resolution_strategy: Due to your high priority issue and previous complaints, we are escalating this to a senior agent to resolve your product issue promptly. We appreciate your loyalty and will prioritize your satisfaction.

results.subject: Request for refund
results.resolution_strategy: Process refund request promptly with clear instructions on refund timeline.
